method.audio: ffmpeg band split per film: voice 250-3500 Hz, bed = <250 Hz + >3500 Hz, air = 4-8 kHz, 100 ms RMS
method.pauses: gaps between consecutive caption word onsets > 0.6 s (proxy: the continuous music bed makes acoustic silence detection unusable)
method.ducking: median bed/air level in speech gaps (>0.8 s) minus median under speech, plus bed level before vs after a speech onset
method.whisper: whisper.cpp ggml-base (int8), 120 s slice per film — independent speed check, not full-length transcription

pauses.measurement_note: True acoustic pauses cannot be isolated here: the music bed fills the voice band, so an energy-based silence detector finds almost nothing. These gaps come from caption word onsets, which cover ~75-90% of the spoken words, so gaps of 0.6-1.0 s are partly caption artefacts. The >=1.5 s list (with timestamps) is the trustworthy part.

ducking.verdict: no ducking: the bed sits at the same level whether the narrator is speaking or silent (|delta| < 2 dB on both probes)
